typedDynamicMessages: prepared-start-server.ts rethrows only the exact typed prepared-source-change text as409
server.ts guidance.message comes from the exact fixed RPC registry; registry tests are recorded separately
server.ts request controls choose between two fixed strings/statuses, not backend diagnostics
manualReview.rpcScope: Six assessment-library sites: shared wrapper plus five worker sites. Worker resolved errors use fixed local errors/counts; rejected RPCs and subsequent SDK behavior remain separate. Five team RPC sites occur because api.team imports assessment helpers; scoped outer errors do not cover successful warning responses.
manualReview.consoleScope: Nine direct calls are in operator/import/QA scripts: fixed cleanup failure guidance/help, aggregate run/draft/storage reports, audio asset metadata and RPC audit output. No CLI/import/worker was executed. Implicit SDK logs, thrown exceptions and private file destinations remain separate.

priorityFinding.mechanism: Three conditional cause.message assignments feed warning in200 JSON; invite/resend also persist last_email_error, and GET returns invitation rows including that historical field.
priorityFinding.reachableFailureKinds: sendTeamEmail nonOK HTTP currently throws a fixed status message and missing config is typed; rejected fetch or SDK update may throw arbitrary Error.message inside the same try. This is a source finding, not evidence that production exposed actual private data.
priorityFinding.next: Use fixed contextual email-warning messages for new responses/writes; normalize previously stored invitation diagnostics in GET without rewriting historical records. Verify actual route with synthetic rejected sends/updates and stored diagnostics; preserve manual fallback links and successful assignment/invitation semantics.

limits: Syntax inventory of assessment library files plus route/script files with direct assessment-path imports. No transitive graph, symbol resolution, shadowing analysis, namespace constructors, computed calls, destructured methods, reexports or appwide coverage.

Dynamic typed messages need manual provenance review; literal syntax alone does not prove safety or correct status/authorization. Direct RPC includes trusted wrapper and unrelated team operations in selected files.

Console/browserStorage counts are direct syntax facts only; not absence of SDK logging, implicit HTTP caches, service workers, indirect persistence or private serialization. No runtime/database/browser/provider/cleanup invocation; no schema/policy/schedule changes.
